about: Every sparkle, glitter and mote used in Astra's three worlds so far, with its source. Unity Unicorn's world sparkle tools panel shows the same list (test/avatar-and-world-tools-test-20261019.mjs keeps them equal).

sparkles.name: Evening Sky sparkle layer
sparkles.what: Twinkling sparkles in three densities, big four-point glints and a faint pink-violet nebula, none near the sun or the horizon; off unless _StarAmount, _GlintAmount or _NebulaAmount is set (stops 02 and 03).

sparkles.name: Sky sparkles
sparkles.what: Up to 900 sparkles drifting far out over the Faraway Field against the sky, twinkling as they grow and shrink (stop 02).

sparkles.name: Field sparkles
sparkles.what: Up to 800 fine glints hanging just above the frond grass along the whole path. The grass shader itself has no glitter; this is the glitter over it (stop 02).

sparkles.name: Door motes
sparkles.what: Rose and gold motes rising in front of each door (LiminalDoorKit.Motes, Soft Glow material).

sparkles.name: Glitter halos
sparkles.what: A cloud of twinkling glitter round each door, thickest at the doorway, up to 700 at the pink door (LiminalDoorKit.GlitterHalo).

sparkles.name: Glitter Paint shader
sparkles.what: Door frames and leaves full of tiny mirror flecks that flash as you walk past and twinkle on their own (Astra: “the door more glittery”).

sparkles.name: Portal glitter
sparkles.what: Sparkles that blink on and off across each portal veil (_Glitter and _GlitterColor in the Portal shader).

sparkles.name: Pool bubbles
sparkles.what: Up to 700 small glowing bubbles rising out of the 220 m pool (stop 03).

sparkles.name: Hall motes
sparkles.what: Up to 800 slow dust motes in the warm air of the pool hall (stop 03).

sparkles.name: Swirling booth sparkles
sparkles.what: Gold and pink sparkles swirling up round the phone booth in a slow helix, with a glow at its base (stop 01).

sparkles.name: Unity Stable/Sparkle shader
sparkles.what: Additive HDR particle shader for glints and motes, bright enough for the bloom; the booth sparkles use it. On Unity Unicorn's main as part of shaders-shop.

sparkles.name: Glitter collection (Upgrade Glitter)
sparkles.what: Thirteen particle effects in one set: fine glitter dust, starbursts, tiny stars, diamond shards, soft bokeh, fairy lights, falling shimmer, rising sparks, confetti flakes, orbiting glints, floating hearts, snow crystals and magic wisps.

sparkles.name: Glitter controls
sparkles.what: The in-world glitter menu: each effect on or off, density, two hues, saturation, brightness and twinkle, shared with everyone in the instance (Udon).

sparkles.name: Glitter Gradient shader
sparkles.what: The glitter collection's particle shader: a drifting two-colour gradient, twinkle, and texture, diamond or confetti shapes.

sparkles.name: Soft Sparkle shader
sparkles.what: A soft additive sparkle dot, used by the stair star dust and the cloud sparkle rain.

sparkles.name: Stair star dust
sparkles.what: Star dust filling the 6.4 m drop under the stair opening (round 1b).

sparkles.name: Round bokeh sparkles
sparkles.what: The round bokeh sparkles from the world's thumbnail, brought back to full size (round 3c).

sparkles.name: Cloud sparkle rain
sparkles.what: Every cloud rains bright white sparkles that sway as they fall and ride along with it, with a switch in the menu (round 3d).

sparkles.name: Sparkle Clouds shader
sparkles.what: Clouds in a two-colour gradient that glitter.

sparkles.name: Lounge cloud sparkles
sparkles.what: Sparkles inside every lounge cloud (the cozy clouds pass).

sparkles.name: Sparkle slurry
sparkles.what: A thick swirling cloud of tiny glitter round every glow orb and egg, always on, that trails when carried (300 per orb, 150 per egg; round 38).

sparkles.name: Celestial Sky stars
sparkles.what: A deep-space sky with nebula clouds and constellations of stars (_Stars).

sparkles.name: Glitter Cloud shader
sparkles.what: Soft rounded cloud shading with twinkling glitter and a slowly shifting pastel tint per cloud; Piranesi House's Stormscape uses a copy.

sparkles.name: Prismatic Stair shader
sparkles.what: Dense pink glitter on the spiral stair, rainbow gradients that drift with height, and HDR sparkles for the bloom; Piranesi House's Stormscape uses a copy.

sparkles.name: Stone mica sparkle
sparkles.what: Glints of mica in the marble and stone, from a sparkle channel in each stone texture's mask (_Sparkle in the Stone shader).

sparkles.name: Sparkle and mote particles
sparkles.what: Atlas particles with a four-ray sparkle, and warm motes rising over the lamps like embers (Piranesi/Particle; M_P_Sparkle and M_P_Mote).

sparkles.name: The Colossus's glittering hand
sparkles.what: Two layers of glitter at the Colossus's hand in the centre hall, under the oculus spot and a narrow golden light, plus sparkle emitters in the halls.
